feedback: The confession follows the strongest previously available inference: Justin's supposed neutralization record was specifically disproved, he carried the clipping and had access to Grant's glass. His account of taking poison during the preview and using the private glass supplies the precise actions, but neither introduces a new investigative mechanism or an inaccessible chemical fact. The admission turns his existing habit of selective history into an emotionally coherent failure, and the last line about the folder surviving him lands well. Chip and Monet's admissions give their persistent denials understandable stakes. I still think the pre-vote case identifies Justin through the character of his lie more securely than through exclusive physical evidence; the finale confirms that inference rather than repairing it.
